items.markdown:
You can extend a tourist visa or visa exemption stamp in Thailand for an additional 30 days by `visiting a local Thai Immigration Office and paying a fee of 1,900 Thai Baht`.[](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aHW1S8x7T-w)[[3]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/84498-faq?menu=5d6636cd15e39c3bd00072ef)

Required Items

- Your original passport with current entry stamp.
- Completed TM.7 extension application form.
- One recent passport-sized photo (4x6 cm).
- Photocopies of your passport photo page, current visa stamp, and departure card (if applicable).
- TM.30 notification form showing proof of your accommodation address in Thailand.
- 1,900 Baht in cash.[](https://findingginamarie.com/articles/thailand-visa-extension-process) [[1]](https://findingginamarie.com/articles/thailand-visa-extension-process)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yrm8oT4_hDc&t=75)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/MusbI6SoNwk)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/8WyIZV0THz4)

Process Steps

- Go to a local immigration office before your current permission to stay expires.
- Fill out the paperwork, get your photo taken, and make photocopies on-site if needed.
- Submit your documents and passport to the officer for review.
- Pay the 1,900 Baht fee and wait for your number to be called to retrieve your passport with the new stamp.[](https://findingginamarie.com/articles/thailand-visa-extension-process) [[1]](https://www.tratimmigration.com/how-to-extend-a-tourist-visa/)
